entities.name: Isshin
entities.description: Human samurai of Kamigawa who joined the Asari Uprising.

entities.name: Asari Uprising
entities.description: Group dedicated to overthrowing the Imperials.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: Government of Kamigawa that trained Isshin.

entities.name: Sokenzanshi
entities.description: Place where Isshin learned of the Asari Uprisers.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: Imperial seat far from Isshin's post.

events.summary: The emperor disappears, splintering the central government; Isshin is dismissed by his destitute lord.
events.quote: but then the emperor disappeared, splintering the central government.

events.summary: Isshin learns of the Asari Uprisers in Sokenzanshi and joins them.
events.quote: There, he learned of the Asari Uprisers , a group dedicated to overthrowing the Imperials and putting the government into the hands of the people.

relations.quote: Now, he fights alongside them hoping to bring freedom to the land.
